title: 第204章 同 意第203章 判断
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
雾气人形发出声音：“狄曼列审判官，你对维罗娜女士做过认知测试和评估，我们认可您的判断。我们需要知道，如果因为你将维罗娜女士牵扯进这件事导致了她的死亡甚至是更加无法接受的结果，你会如何？”
话音落下，那无穷无尽的目光全部集中在了狄曼列身上，仿佛要将他看穿
“去弥补，去改变。如果做不到”，狄曼列眼神平静的开口：“会愧疚、痛苦、悔恨、悲伤，然后遵循秩序继续向前”
闻言，维罗娜忍不住转头看向了狄曼列，璀璨的双眸中多了一抹难以言喻的炽热感情
对于狄曼列的回答，审判庭的成员们没有什么意外，毕竟他们也不是第一天认识狄曼列了
一名身体大半被岩石与金属覆盖的矮人开口道：“狄曼列审判官，按照你提交的资料。如果这个计划能够实施，那么维罗娜女士肯定会接触到你的记忆，你的记忆中包含了太多机密，我们认为风险太大”
“资料中也说了，我会优先挑选安全的记忆与她对接”
“如果恢复你的伤势需要对接更多的记忆呢？你会就此停下吗？”
“不会，如果这个计划真的可行，你们比我更清楚应该怎么选择”
“但你知晓的许多事都有危险，先不说那些事本身会给维罗娜女士带去的危险。如果她泄露这些事为世界带去了麻烦，甚至她站在秩序的对立面，知晓了这些事的她造成难以估量的后果又该怎么办？”
狄曼列微微抬眼：“她的认知与观念处于秩序一侧”
“但她并非秩序，若是她发生了改变，成为了不可控的因素呢？”
“我会负责”，狄曼列靠近维罗娜一步，眼眸中看不见丝毫的情绪：“所有预防措施，不同情况的善后手段，都已经准备好”
轻握手杖，狄曼列继续开口：“关于维罗娜的一切，我来担保。我做出这个决定，不止是我对她的信任，还有考虑和判断”
话音落下，异端审判庭的成员们短暂安静了一下，接着便看向狄曼列与维罗娜：
“好的，我们明白了。接下来我们需要正式商讨，请你们二位先离开一下吧，很快的”
“好”
狄曼列点了点头，牵起维罗娜的手走向了来时的门扉
狄曼列清楚，异端审判庭成员口中的很快仅仅是针对审判庭之外的。而对这些审判庭成员而言，根据不同的议题区分。讨论、模拟、争辩、推翻、敲定可，这些步骤完成可能需要几年甚至几百年
这对他们的精神与意志是一种巨大的损耗与折磨，但却是必须的。在这个危险的世界中，走错任何一步都有可能万劫不复

秩序，绝不能由个人意志决定
这也是异端审判庭存在的理由，需要不同时代、不同种族、不同维度、不同世界、不同视角去裁决秩序道路上的每一件事
而狄曼列本身的存在与这次议题的重要程度，都意味着这次议题的讨论将持续很长时间
刚才的发问，更多的是在根据维罗娜的回答与反应判断她是否能参与这项计划，同时也是顺便对狄曼列的日常评估
接下来，才是真正的裁决时刻。
这项计划牵扯到的事太多，需要讨论的事项也太多。更何况异端审判庭的成员们所持有的意见都各不相同，甚至相反意见的也不在少数
狄曼列以前也会参与裁决，他有这种资格和能力。漫长的时间对他来说并非难以承受
但自从狄曼列受伤后，他的情况显然不适合进行这种可能涉及高维度与其他世界的行为
随着维罗娜与狄曼列跨过门扉，眼前的场景再次回到了异端审判局的总部。维罗娜也放松长长的舒了一口气
“呼─────”
维罗娜拍了拍胸口，有些紧张的看向狄曼列：“典狱长大人，那里好可怕.......”
“确实”，狄曼列点了点头：“而且什么东西都有”
维罗娜思考了一下：“唔，里面和外面的时间流速是不是不一样啊？”
“嗯，毕竟他们需要很长时间去裁决，对我们来说很快”
说话间，狄曼列的通讯终端亮了起来，正是异端审判庭发来的
狄曼列笑了笑：“看，结束了”
说着，狄曼列拍了拍维罗娜的腰肢：“难受的话留在这吧，我进去就好”
维罗娜摇了摇头，微笑道：“我没事的，差不多适应了”
“好，走吧”
说完，二人转身再次跨越门扉，那被无尽人影填满的螺旋议事厅也再次浮现

维罗娜略微抬头，发现许多审判庭成员的精神状态甚至身体都出现了不同程度的变化。尽管审判庭肯定有着稳定心智的手段，但漫长时间对他们中的大部分还是会缓慢的造成不可逆的后果
见到狄曼列与维罗娜出现，雾气人形发出了冷漠而肃穆的声音：
“狄曼列审判官，关于你本次提交的议题，审判庭的裁决是”
“同意”
：。：
content_en:
The mist humanoid made a voice: "Judge Dimanlie, you have conducted cognitive tests and assessments on Ms. Verona, and we recognize your judgment. We need to know, what would you do if your involvement of Ms. Verona in this matter led to her death or even an even more unacceptable result?"
After the words fell, the endless gazes were all focused on Dimanlie, as if they wanted to see through him.
"To make up for it, to change it. If you can't do it," Dimanlie said with calm eyes, "I will feel guilty, painful, regretful, and sad, and then I will continue to move forward in accordance with the order."
Hearing this, Verona couldn't help turning her head to look at Diamanlie, with an indescribable fiery emotion in her bright eyes.
Regarding Diamanlie's answer, the members of the Tribunal were not surprised. After all, this was not the first day they had known Diamanlie.
A dwarf whose body was mostly covered with rocks and metal said: "Judge Dimanlie, according to the information you submitted. If this plan can be implemented, then Ms. Verona will definitely have access to your memory. Your memory contains too many secrets, and we think the risk is too high."
"The information also says that I will give priority to choosing safe memories to connect with her."
"What if recovering from your injury requires access to more memories? Will you stop here?"
"No, if this plan is really feasible, you know better than me what choice to make."
"But many of the things you know are dangerous, not to mention the danger those things themselves will bring to Ms. Verona. What if she reveals these things and brings trouble to the world, or even stands on the opposite side of order. What if she knows these things and causes incalculable consequences?"
Diamanlie raised his eyes slightly: "Her cognition and concepts are on the order side."
"But she is not orderly. What if she changes and becomes an uncontrollable factor?"
"I will be responsible." Dimanlie took a step closer to Verona, with no emotion in his eyes: "All preventive measures and aftermath measures for different situations have been prepared."
Lightly shaking his cane, Diamanlie continued: "I will vouch for everything about Verona. I made this decision not only because of my trust in her, but also because of my consideration and judgment."
After the words fell, the members of the Heretic Tribunal were quiet for a brief moment, and then looked at Demanlie and Verona:
"Okay, we understand. Next we need to formally discuss it. Please leave for a while. It will be soon."
"good"
Diamanlie nodded, took Verona's hand and walked towards the door from which he came.
Diamenlie knew that what the members of the Heretic Tribunal were talking about was only aimed at those outside the Tribunal. For these tribunal members, they are distinguished according to different issues. Discussion, simulation, debate, overturning, and finalization may take several years or even hundreds of years to complete.
This is a huge loss and torture to their spirit and will, but it is necessary. In this dangerous world, any wrong step could lead to disaster
Order cannot be determined by individual will
This is also the reason why the Heretic Tribunal exists. It requires different eras, different races, different dimensions, different worlds, and different perspectives to judge everything on the road to order.
The existence of Demanlie itself and the importance of this issue mean that the discussion of this issue will last for a long time.
The question just now is more about judging whether Verona can participate in this plan based on her answers and reactions. It is also a daily assessment of Diamanlie.
Next, is the real moment of judgment.
There is so much involved in this plan and so much to discuss. What's more, the members of the Heretic Tribunal hold different opinions, and there are even a few who have opposite opinions.
Diamanlie has also participated in adjudication before, and he has this qualification and ability. The long hours are not too much for him to bearBut since Diamanlie was injured, his condition is obviously not suitable for such behavior that may involve higher dimensions and other worlds.
As Verona and Demanlie stepped through the door, the scene before them returned to the headquarters of the Inquisition. Verona also relaxed and let out a long sigh of relief.
“Hoo─────”
Verona patted her chest and looked at Diamanlie nervously: "Master Warden, it's so scary there..."
"Indeed," Diamanlie nodded: "And there is everything."
Verona thought for a moment: "Well, is the flow of time different inside and outside?"
"Well, after all, it takes them a long time to rule, but it's fast for us."
As he spoke, Diamanlie's communication terminal lit up. It was the message from the Heretic Tribunal.
Diamanlie smiled: "Look, it's over."
With that said, Diamanlie patted Verona's waist: "If you feel uncomfortable, just stay here, I'll just go in."
Verona shook her head and smiled: "I'm fine, I'm almost getting used to it."
"Okay, let's go"
After saying that, the two turned around and crossed the door again, and the spiral meeting hall filled with endless figures emerged again.
Verona raised her head slightly and found that many members of the Tribunal had experienced varying degrees of mental state and even physical changes. Although the Inquisition certainly has means to stabilize their minds, long periods of time will slowly have irreversible consequences for most of them.
Seeing Diamanlie and Verona appear, the mist figure made a cold and solemn voice:
"Judge Dimanlie, regarding the issue you submitted this time, the ruling of the trial court is"
"Agree"
